text:
maya: heads-up while onboarding Solstice's LoRA adapter (solstice-lora-1.4). mini-smoke shows the int4 path sometimes emits scientific notation for large invoice totals (e.g. 1.02e3) instead of formatted currency. fp16/int8 fine. anyone seen scientific-notation flips after quant?

olaf: whoa. can you paste a tiny example?

maya: redacted sample below:

```
input: "Invoice total: $1,020.50"
expected: "Total: $1,020.50"
fp16: "Total: $1,020.50"
int4: "Total: 1.0205e3"  <-- sci notation, breaks downstream parsers
```

jin: interesting. two possible sources: 1) adapter introduced tokens that split the numeric span causing the model to prefer generating an exponent token; 2) quantization noise shifts logits so the model generates a compact numeric token sequence interpreted as sci notation.

maya: merge config: base-en-v3 + graft: solstice-currencypack (adds currency subtokens and thousands tokens). repro only when graft + int4.

eval-bot: quick-run (n=120): graft+int4: 11/120 sci-notation or truncated-cents errors; graft+int8: 0/120; base-only+int4: 2/120. latency int4 ~ -18% vs fp16. artifacts: s3://redwood-eval/solstice/solstice-lora-1.4/2876543210/

olaf: can you dump token sequence for a failing case (token ids, detok pre/postproc)?

maya: token dump for one fail:

```
# token ids (grafted): [10, 5050, 9996, 402, 5011, 77, 11]
# detok before postproc: "Total: 1 020 . 5 0"
# postproc -> "1,020.50"
# int4 model decode -> "1 . 0 2 0 5 e 3"  (tokens that form sci notation)
```

jin: that token stream looks like the model is generating an exponent token (e) plus digit grouping under int4 scoring. Likely a logit-margin collapse for the more verbose numeric subtoken sequence.

maya: ran `--force-postproc` and beam=4 experiment. force-postproc recovered 7/11; beam=4 recovered 2 more; 2 cases still produce sci notation.

olaf: mitigation ideas: 1) short-term pin Solstice to int8 for canary to avoid downstream parser failures; 2) add a decode-time bias to prefer keeping decimal-related tokens when inside numeric spans; 3) include grafted numeric tokens in quant calibration so int4 preserves the logit gap; 4) add a quick parser-safety unit test in the graft merge CI that rejects outputs that match /e\+?\d+/ for invoice fields.

maya: opening ticket ML-2109 with artifacts and token dumps: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-2109. attaching s3 artifact and recommended rollout.

eval-bot: artifact created: s3://redwood-eval/solstice/solstice-lora-1.4/2876543210/ (token-streams, eval CSV, logs).

infra-bot: scheduled canary pin: solstice-lora-1.4 -> int8 on stack-2 at 2876543235.

jin: also add a small smoke that runs the invoice parser against outputs and fails the merge if any invoice line contains exponent notation. Quick regex: `/\be[-+]?[0-9]+\b/i`.

maya: adding the unit test to merge CI now. will ping when green. thanks all. :thumbsup:
